description: Compares two to four providers side by side at one dose and plan: monthly price, total due today, renewal price and coupon, ratings and their recent movement, the share of positive reviews on customer support, shipping and product quality, how fast each answers email, pharmacies used in a US state with licence status, features, and links.getStarted for the plan compared. The drug and dosage_mg inputs set the shared dose. Without a dose, each row uses that provider’s cheapest plan, and the doses can differ.

currently_taking_glp1.description: Whether the person already takes a GLP-1. Starter packs are for new patients. When this is omitted, a starter plan can appear among the results.

dosage_mg.description: Weekly dose in mg the prices share. When omitted, each provider’s cheapest plan is used, and the doses can differ.

drug.description: The molecule the prices are for: semaglutide or tirzepatide.

plan_type.description: The kind of plan the comparison is limited to, or "any".

providers.description: Two to four providers to compare, each by name, slug or numeric GLP Winner id.

state.description: The person’s US state, as a two-letter code ("TX") or a full name ("Texas"). Which providers are available, and some prices, depend on the state.

name: compare_glp1_providers
title: Compare providers side by side
